_comment_pre-push: The PUSH GATE: the security checks that must pass before anything leaves the machine.
tracked-secrets catches a secret git already tracks (.gitignore cannot help there).
web-exposure catches a static web root that is a source tree, or a path gate that decides
on the raw request path while the file is read from the decoded one — the RetroSix Live
disclosure of 29 Aug 2026. Both are fast; neither needs the app built or running.
